outcome: Give development director / property operations head a governed method to improve days of site stoppage due to material using POs, supplier dispatches and site receiving logs, with final decisions…
overview: Construction Material Delivery Coordination addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in construction and real estate operations. The first proof of value uses POs, supplier dispatches and site receiving logs. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is days of site stoppage due to material, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: days of site stoppage due to material

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: POs, supplier dispatches and site receiving logs; define days of site stoppage due to material and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Development Director / Property Operations Head.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for days of site stoppage due to material
